name: Hybrid Kd Tree Traversal
definition: A data structure where a volume is split into bricks, and a Kd tree organizes these bricks. Leaf nodes of the Kd tree point to specific brick types (Dense, Octree, Voxel List) or are empty, allowing efficient spatial access to heterogeneous volume data.
summary: Hybrid Kd Tree Traversal efficiently accesses heterogeneous volume data by grouping distinct brick types into a hierarchical Kd tree, enabling specialized, type-specific access routines at the leaves.
